The '''Malastare Ambassador's residence''' was where the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and representatives resided, including [[Pax Teem]], who ordered some [[Maladian]] [[assassin]]s to kill [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]] during one of the [[Order of the Canted Circle]]'s meetings, which proved futile and provoked [[Palpatine/Legends|Senator Palpatine]] to kill all the Protectorate members in the building and also burn the building.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Malastare Ambassador's residence was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
